learn.canDo: Design a pipeline for fast, trustworthy feedback: cheap checks first, parallel and cached, flaky tests quarantined.
learn.why: A slow or noisy pipeline changes how a team behaves. Interviewers ask how you would speed one up.
learn.keyIdea: Fast feedback, and red that means something.

learn.canDo: Run a plan, review, apply workflow with remote locked state, and detect and reconcile drift.
learn.why: 'It works in staging' often means the environments differ. Code as the only path to change fixes that.
learn.keyIdea: The code is true only if it is the only way things change.

chapter.story: Deploys are slow, environments differ, and nobody trusts the pipeline.
outcomes: Design a fast, trusted CI pipeline
chapter.why: Shipping is a loop of change, check and release. Making the loop fast and repeatable is most of what DevOps means.
chapter.payoff: In an interview you can design a pipeline and an infrastructure workflow. At work you will make both faster and safer.
